name: Demo queue — different meanings
note: A tiny demonstration queue. It exists to prove the Decision Deck takes gesture meanings from the QUEUE FILE, not from its own code: this queue assigns completely different meanings (up = approve, down = reject, hold = escalate) from the road-review queue (right = delete, left = keep, double-tap = skip), and the same deck build reads both correctly. The items are invented paperwork, not game data.
